channel.title: Okendo - Product Releases
channel.description: New features and updates to Okendo (unofficial feed).

item.title: [Reviews] Custom attribute translations
item.description:
Custom attribute translations — Override auto-generated translations to match your brand voice or terminology.
(Enhancement / Reviews - August 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Track review performance by more channels
item.description:
Track review performance by more channels — See how performance changes across two new channels in the Capture tab in Reviews Performance Reporting, Integrations and Shopify Account Extensions.
(Enhancement / Reporting / Reviews - August 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn review attributes into actionable insights
item.description:
Turn review attributes into actionable insights — A new reporting module for product attributes, including a Trend tab for tracking performance over time and a Spotlight tab for product and group deep-dives. Allowing you to make smarter product and marketing decisions, faster.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - August 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Advancements to translation capabilities
item.description:
Advancements to translation capabilities — Increase translation support in the reviews widget and recorder. Ability to translate attribute labels, values, and filters, and review replies.
(Enhancement / Reviews - August 2026)

item.title: [Surveys] Additional data included in Shopify Flow triggers
item.description:
Additional data included in Shopify Flow triggers — ‘Survey Response Created’ and ‘Quiz Response Created’ flow triggers now include the raw question and answer data, and ‘Quiz Response Created’ flow triggers now includes the product recommendation data.
(Enhancement / Quizzes / Surveys - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Filter reviews by clicking on the star rating in the widget header
item.description:
Filter reviews by clicking on the star rating in the widget header — The star rating distribution in the reviews widget header is now clickable, shoppers can tap any star rating to instantly filter the review list to just that rating.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect site reviews in customer account extensions
item.description:
Collect site reviews in customer account extensions — Let customers rate their overall experience with your brand, covering things like customer service, delivery, and their shopping experience now directly in their Shopify customer account.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Set attributes as optional
item.description:
Set attributes as optional — Set any attribute, product or profile, as optional when adding them to an attribute collection, allowing for greater customization of the review journey, reducing friction for shoppers.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Custom tag IDs are now visible and copyable in the admin
item.description:
Custom tag IDs are now visible and copyable in the admin — Merchants can now see and copy the ID for any custom tag directly from their Reviews Widget settings.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Merchants can now include incentivized status when exporting
item.description:
Merchants can now include incentivized status when exporting — Review exports now include incentivized status, showing whether a review was incentivized with a coupon, loyalty points or gifted.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Merchants can now specify a review status when importing reviews
item.description:
Merchants can now specify a review status when importing reviews — Set the status of imported reviews as pending, approved, or rejected.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Sync customer profile data to Shopify metafields
item.description:
Sync customer profile data to Shopify metafields — Make Okendo survey, quiz, and loyalty profile data available in Shopify segmentation, Flow automations, and reporting, and pass it to connected platforms like Klaviyo. Put your data to work to build richer segments and trigger more targeted automations, all without leaving Shopify.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect reviews for bundles, individual items, or both
item.description:
Collect reviews for bundles, individual items, or both — Ask customers to review the bundle as a whole, the individual items inside it, or both. Ensure your review requests feel relevant and your product pages build the social proof that matters most.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - May 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Transform customer engagement with auto review replies
item.description:
Transform customer engagement with auto review replies — AI-generated replies to reviews can now be configured based on review sentiment. Configure per-sentiment toggles, word limits, reply delays and privacy settings from your Reviews settings.
(General availability (GA) / New feature / Reviews - May 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Pre-fill details for logged-in shoppers
item.description:
Pre-fill details for logged-in shoppers — When a shopper is logged into your store, Okendo now automatically pre-fills their email address and name across every Okendo surface they encounter. Shoppers spend less time entering details and more time completing the actions that matter; leaving reviews, joining loyalty programs, sharing referrals, and more.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - May 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn customer accounts into a review engine
item.description:
Turn customer accounts into a review engine — Drive review volume by activating Shopify’s customer account experience. Add review CTAs to order history, highlight unreviewed products, and make leaving feedback effortless.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - April 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Video transcription & accessibility for reviews media
item.description:
Video transcription & accessibility for reviews media — AI-generated video transcriptions and image alt-tags are now automatically created for reviews with media attached, surfacing inline subtitles and full transcripts in the storefront media modal and admin moderation panel.
(Enhancement / Reviews - March 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] HTTP Block for Sequences
item.description:
HTTP Block for Sequences — You can now forward sequence data from Okendo to external tools using a configurable HTTP request.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - February 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Configurable selection limits for multi-select questions
item.description:
Configurable selection limits for multi-select questions — You can now set minimum and maximum selection limits on multi-select questions across Product attributes, Profile questions, Surveys, and Quizzes. The maximum limit of options that are able to be selected has also been increased from 5 to 10.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - February 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Make data-driven decisions with Okendo’s updated performance reporting
item.description:
Make data-driven decisions with Okendo’s updated performance reporting — Access a rich set of review data to better understand product performance, customer sentiment, review capture, and more.
(General availability (GA) / Reporting / Reviews - February 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] New Okendo Loyalty properties & events in Omnisend
item.description:
New Okendo Loyalty properties & events in Omnisend — Okendo Loyalty now syncs custom contact properties and events to Omnisend, enabling segmentation and automation based on loyalty program data.
(General availability (GA) / Integration / Okendo Platform - February 2026)

item.title: [Surveys] Survey & Quiz responses now available via API
item.description:
Survey & Quiz responses now available via API — New Merchant REST API endpoints let you fetch a list of responses for Surveys and Quizzes, making it easier to sync data with your systems and external reporting tools.
(Enhancement / Quizzes / Surveys - January 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect reviews directly from inboxes with In-Mail
item.description:
Collect reviews directly from inboxes with In-Mail — In-Mail makes it easy for shoppers to submit reviews straight from their email. Designed for a frictionless experience, it removes redirects for a faster, smoother path to sharing feedback.
(Reviews - September 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Increase accessibility on review images
item.description:
Increase accessibility on review images — Boost accessibility and SEO with auto-generated alt text for customer photos, making your store more inclusive and easier to discover.
(New feature / Reviews - August 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn AI Summaries into global social proof
item.description:
Turn AI Summaries into global social proof — Shoppers can translate AI Summaries into their preferred language for a localized experience that builds trust and boosts conversions.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2025)

item.title: [Surveys] Unlock deeper insights with survey data
item.description:
Unlock deeper insights with survey data — Push responses to the tools you use every day to automate alerts, create support tickets, and generate actionable insights with Surveys Webhooks
(Surveys - July 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Pre-built Flows now available in Klaviyo
item.description:
Pre-built Flows now available in Klaviyo — Ready-to-use templates are now live in Klaviyo’s Flow Library for Reviews and Loyalty—so you can launch high-performing automations faster and with less effort.
(Integration / Loyalty / Reviews - July 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Make your data go further with Reviews Webhooks
item.description:
Make your data go further with Reviews Webhooks — Send real-time review insights to any tool in your tech stack, fueling personalized experiences and advanced workflows.
(New feature / Reviews - June 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Integrate Okendo with Iterable
item.description:
Integrate Okendo with Iterable — Easily incorporate Okendo data into your Iterable journeys and templates, enabling personalized and timely communications that engage your customers. Enhance your messaging with rich customer data like reviews, loyalty status, and more.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - June 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Personalize every message with Braze
item.description:
Personalize every message with Braze — Sync Okendo data to Braze to create more relevant, impactful customer journeys. Build stronger relationships and drive more conversions with messages that resonate.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - May 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Postscript integration now supports all Okendo products
item.description:
Postscript integration now supports all Okendo products — Okendo now sends profile and event data from all products to Postscript, making it easier to build personalized flows, and targeted campaigns.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - May 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Connect to Klaviyo with OAuth authentication
item.description:
Connect to Klaviyo with OAuth authentication — Connect Okendo to Klaviyo via secure OAuth authentication for faster setup, improved security, and easier account connection.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - April 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn social proof into sales with TikTok Shop
item.description:
Turn social proof into sales with TikTok Shop — Expand your reach by syndicating reviews directly to TikTok Shop. Build trust, influence purchase decisions and convert more shoppers with social proof.
(Integration / New feature / Reviews - March 2025)

item.title: [Reporting] Boost engagement with VIP Tier insights
item.description:
Boost engagement with VIP Tier insights — Gain deeper insights into your VIP tiers, helping you track performance, monitor member progression, and refine strategies to boost engagement and loyalty program success.
(New feature / Loyalty / Reporting - March 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Save time with auto-published AI Summaries
item.description:
Save time with auto-published AI Summaries — AI-generated review summaries can now auto-publish once created, saving you time on manual approvals. This optional setting makes it easier to streamline review management.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Drive sales with stackable discounts
item.description:
Drive sales with stackable discounts — Okendo-generated discounts can now be combined with any Shopify discounts across Reviews, Loyalty, Quizzes, and Referrals and Surveys. Give customers more ways to save while driving engagement and sales.
(Okendo Platform - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Deeper insights with enhanced review data exports
item.description:
Deeper insights with enhanced review data exports — Review exports now include upvote and downvote counts, giving you greater visibility into customer sentiment and helping you make more informed, data-driven decisions.
(Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Highlight customer media with featured reviews tags
item.description:
Highlight customer media with featured reviews tags — Featured tags are now supported in the media grid and media carousel widgets, giving you more flexibility in how they display user generated content.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect more reviews with Customer Accounts
item.description:
Collect more reviews with Customer Accounts — Brands with a launched Loyalty program can now enable product reviews in Shopify Customer Accounts, making it easier to collect feedback from past purchases.
(Integration / Loyalty / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] AI Summaries for faster review insights
item.description:
AI Summaries for faster review insights — Increase conversions with AI-generated review summaries. Turn high-volume social proof into clear insights, helping shoppers buy with confidence.
(New feature / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Expanded review request email eligibility
item.description:
Expanded review request email eligibility — Orders no longer need a first or last name to receive review request emails sent through Okendo, making it easier to collect more customer reviews.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Display product reviews on TikTok Shop
item.description:
Display product reviews on TikTok Shop — Leverage your verified post-purchase reviews to build trust and boost social proof on TikTok Shop with our new Aftership integration.
(Integration / Reviews - January 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Czech language support
item.description:
Czech language support — Build stronger connections with Czech speaking customers and deliver a localized experience with Czech translations, available across all products.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - November 2024)

item.title: [Reviews] Highlight your top reviews
item.description:
Highlight your top reviews — Build trust, boost credibility, and drive confident purchases by curating top customer feedback with Featured Reviews.
(New feature / Reviews - October 2024)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Recharge integration
item.description:
Recharge integration — Seamlessly sync discount codes between Okendo and Recharge, so customers can redeem rewards on subscriptions directly in the Recharge customer portal.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - October 2024)

item.title: [Reviews] Review translations
item.description:
Review translations — Maximize the impact of your social proof and build trust in international markets with on-demand translations.
(New feature / Reviews - September 2024)

item.title: [Reporting] Loyalty insights page
item.description:
Loyalty insights page — Access new metrics and deeper insights that help you make quick changes and maximize results.
(New feature / Loyalty / Reporting - August 2024)

item.title: [Surveys] Boost survey completion with progress tracking
item.description:
Boost survey completion with progress tracking — Add a progress bar to your surveys to boost completion rates and reduce drop-offs by helping respondents track their progress, especially in longer surveys.
(Enhancement / Surveys - July 2024)

item.title: [Reporting] Loyalty dashboard improvements for performance insights
item.description:
Loyalty dashboard improvements for performance insights — Review your loyalty program’s performance and ROI with new dashboards that provide summaries and detailed views of revenue impact, member behavior, points accumulation, and coupon usage.
(Enhancement / Loyalty / Reporting - June 2024)

item.title: [Reporting] Filter and view Quiz responses by conversions
item.description:
Filter and view Quiz responses by conversions — You can now filter quiz responses by add-to-cart or purchase events in the Responses tab to validate attributed revenue, track conversion data, and gain insights into user behavior.
(Quizzes / Reporting - June 2024)

item.title: [Reviews] Triple Whale Integration
item.description:
Triple Whale Integration — Connect your Okendo Reviews data with Triple Whale analytics for deeper insights into how customer feedback influences marketing performance to help you make smarter, data-driven decisions.
(Integration / Reviews - May 2024)

item.title: [Surveys] Enhanced post-checkout surveys with Shopify extensions
item.description:
Enhanced post-checkout surveys with Shopify extensions — Shopify Plus merchants can now prompt customers for insights using post-checkout surveys. These surveys can be integrated into Thank You pages using Checkout Extensibility and the Okendo Surveys app block.
(Integration / Surveys - April 2024)
